events.content: Identifying the issue: the product page is a single async server component that awaits `getInventory()` (which calls `connection()`), so the entire page—including the static `<h1>`—waits for that slow work. Splitting the page: render the title immediately and wrap only the inventory fetch in `Suspense`. Adding route metadata so the document title updates promptly.
